events.title: Inner Product separates exponential cofactor count from compact exact projection
formal_statement: IP_k(x,y)=XOR_i(x_i AND y_i) has O(k) B2 size.
Fixing all x bits produces exactly 2^k distinct y-cofactors, one parity function for each subset of y variables.
Nevertheless exists x_1...x_k IP_k(x,y) equals OR_i y_i and therefore has O(k) B2 size.
Moreover exists x_i [(x_i AND y_i) XOR R] equals y_i OR R when R is x_i-independent, yielding a polynomial family-specific stagewise projection algorithm.
Therefore enumerating/caching every distinct cofactor before compression can be exponentially wasteful even when the exact projected function is small.

provider_receipt.workflow: Validate Akinator U1I Inner Product Projection

events.claim_ceiling: This is a family-specific separator/positive control. It is not a lower bound on minimum B2 projection size for arbitrary formulas and does not establish universal smart compression.

events.title: Recognizing even the constant-TRUE exact projection target is coNP-complete in general B2 scope
formal_statement: Define PROJ_TRUE_B2: given C(x,y), decide whether exists x C is identically TRUE over y.
NO has a polynomial witness y with C(0,y)=C(1,y)=0, so the problem is in coNP.
For arbitrary F(y), let C_F=x AND F. Then exists x C_F=F, so PROJ_TRUE_B2 is TRUE iff F is a tautology; hence coNP-hard.
Therefore exact recognition of a proposed simple projection target cannot be treated as a free semantic operation.
The more general target-equivalence problem R(y) <-> exists x C(x,y) is also coNP-complete by taking R=TRUE.
events.claim_ceiling: coNP-completeness is an analytical theorem, not produced by CI. Syntactic/proof-carrying rewrite libraries remain viable; only unrestricted semantic target recognition is closed as a free operation.

active_front.name: U1_I3_PROOF_CARRYING_REWRITE_COMPLETENESS
active_front.question: Can a polynomially matchable/proof-carrying library of local projection rewrites keep every exact variable-elimination stage polynomial for arbitrary frozen-B2 states without semantic target recognition or exponential rewrite-sequence search?
